messages:
inc_bot: PagerDuty alert fired for service=hosted-inference (P-12345). Escalation policy 'night-ops' triggered: primary oncall paged. Page status: UNACKED -> escalating to secondary in 3m. Details: https://pagerduty.com/incidents/P-12345 :rotating_light:
pagerduty_bot: Auto-escalation: primary did not acknowledge. Secondary (Tayla R) paged. Manager escalation will fire if no ack in 8m.
Sam (oncall): i got the primary page but i'm on-call handoff from earlier and haven't seen mobile because dnd. sorry, won't be able to fully own this right now.
Tayla R: acked. I'm on it. seeing spike in 5xx from gen-api routing. hooking into kibana now. :eyes:
Marco L: thanks, tayla. I can help with traffic steering. which model is affected?
Tayla R: looks like redwood/finetune-2026@v3 is returning 503s at ~30% of requests for sequences >1024. Other variants ok. suspect KV-cache eviction + new kernel heuristics.
Jess: confirmed from traces — KV cache miss + kernel fallback path causing mem pressure and OOM-ish responses, tasks killed and 503s. quick mitigation: reduce batch_size and route long-seq to v2-fallback.
Tayla R: doing a quick route change: 
```
rdwctl route set --service hosted-inference --condition "seq_len>1024" --model redwood/v2-fallback --weight 100
```
Tayla R: applied. observing error rate drop on a subset.
Marco L: i'll scale the serving pool for v3 to buy time: 
```
kubectl scale deployment inference-v3 --replicas=12 -n rwd-prod
```
Marco L: replicas increasing, though cold-starts mean a short latency bump.
Sam (oncall): thanks tayla & marco. i'm available to pick up post-mortem and coordinate downstream customer comms. handing off active ownership to Tayla.
Tayla R: taking ownership. marking incident P-12345 as acknowledged by me in PD. updated incident description: "partial customer impact: 5xx for long sequences on v3 for hosted API; mitigated by routing to v2-fallback and scaling v3 pool"
pagerduty_bot: Manager escalation suppressed (ack received by secondary). No manager page sent.
Jess: monitoring dashboards look better — 5xx rate down from 30%->6% over 10m. Latency for routed traffic up ~120ms but no 503s.
OpsManager: good work. please capture timeline + impact for postmortem. Was any paying customer hit or large SLA breach?
Tayla R: customers with high long-seq traffic (search-sandbox and ai-labs) saw errors; i'll pull list and contact CSMs. estimate ~2% of active customers saw degraded experience for ~18m.
Marco L: root cause hypothesis: new kernel selection path + continuous batching heuristics interact poorly under a specific sequence length distribution, causing KV cache thrash and OOM-like task terminations.
Sam (oncall): next steps: 1) incident writeup + timeline (sam) 2) hotfix: disable new kernel path for v3 until regression fix (marco) 3) longer-term: add evals for seq_len distribution and canary ramp for kernel changes (taylor/product).
Jess: i've opened a follow-up runbook PR with immediate mitigation steps and the rdwctl commands we used. link: https://git.redwood/ops/runbooks/p12345-mitigation
Tayla R: marking incident as 'mitigated' in PD, leaving it open for postmortem. handing back to morning oncall for followups.
Sam (oncall): ack. i'll coordinate postmortem and customer comms tomorrow morning. thanks everyone for quick turnaround. :thumbsup:
inc_bot: Incident P-12345 status: MITIGATED. Severity: Sev2. Assigned owner: Tayla R. Postmortem required: yes.
OpsManager: add to weekly ops review. close loop on canary gating for kernel rollouts.
Tayla R: adding notes to incident ticket now, will include logs, routing diff, and timeline. bedtime for me — leave any follow-ups and i'll pick up morning.
